name: Dextrose
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text

item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Supplies glucose as substrate, 5% is hypotonic once glucose is metabolised (free water), 10–50% raise blood glucose

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Dextrose, IV as bolus, 250–500 mg/kg. · Follow with 6–12 mg/kg/minute or more until blood glucose is within the physiological range. (10% Dextrose = 10 g dextrose/100 mL).

contraindications.t: Hypotonic solutions in raised intracranial pressure

cautions.t: Give thiamine before glucose in alcohol dependence or malnutrition

adverse_effects.t: Hyperglycaemia, hyponatraemia with hypotonic solutions, hypokalaemia, phlebitis and tissue necrosis on extravasation of 50%
